name: VTN
description: Combines self-attention with a variational autoencoder to learn global design rules and synthesize diverse layouts (CVPR 2021).

name: AC-LayoutGAN
description: Generates graphic layouts conditioned on element attributes such as area, aspect ratio, and reading order with an attribute-conditioned GAN (TVCG).
date_note: IEEE early-access publication predates arXiv v1 and 2021 issue

name: DesignScape
description: Provides interactive refinement and brainstorming layout suggestions that improve position, scale, and alignment during graphic-design authoring (CHI 2015).

name: LayoutGCN
description: Learns structural layout-similarity embeddings with a graph-convolutional encoder and convolutional decoder for retrieval over interface layouts (ECCV 2020).

name: Vinci
description: Introduces an intelligent graphic-design system that composes advertising posters from user-provided product assets and design intent (CHI 2021).

name: De-Rendering Stylized Texts
description: Vectorizes rasterized display text into editable content, geometry, font, styling, effects, and hidden-background parameters through differentiable rendering (ICCV 2021).

name: LayoutDM: Transformer-Based Diffusion Model for Layout Generation
description: Instantiates conditional DDPM layout generation with a purely Transformer-based denoiser for diverse, high-quality conditional layouts (CVPR 2023).

name: PDA-GAN
description: Uses GAN-based unsupervised domain adaptation with a pixel-level discriminator to generate image-aware advertising-poster layouts (CVPR 2023).

name: CG4CTR
description: Builds a Stable-Diffusion-based advertising-creative generation pipeline that incorporates user preferences and downstream click-through-rate ranking (WWW 2024 Companion).

name: Spot the Error
description: Improves non-autoregressive graphic-layout generation with a learned wireframe locator that identifies erroneous layout tokens for iterative refinement (AAAI 2024).

name: CoLay
description: Uses multi-conditional latent diffusion to generate layouts with style properties from flexible combinations of text, guidelines, element types, and partial designs.

name: Revision Matters
description: Fine-tunes a Gemini multimodal backbone on human revision traces to iteratively refine generated layouts toward expert design edits.
date_note: arXiv v1 metadata reports first submission 2024-05-27

name: PostDoc
description: Generates posters from long multimodal documents using learned submodular content selection, LLM paraphrasing, and content-conditioned template generation (AAAI 2025).

name: Neural Contrast
description: Uses diffusion-based generative editing to create low-saliency, high-contrast regions beneath design assets for improved graphic-design readability (PRICAI 2024).

name: Alfie
description: Modifies the inference behavior of a pretrained Diffusion Transformer to generate easily isolated RGBA-style illustration assets without additional training (ECCV 2024 AI4VA Workshop).

name: LGGPT
description: Unifies multiple layout-generation tasks and domains with compact instruction and response encodings for a 1.5B-parameter large language model.

name: BizGen
description: Generates infographic and slide imagery from article-length prompts and ultra-dense layouts using layout-guided cross-attention and region-wise latent refinement (CVPR 2025).

name: READ: Recursive Autoencoders for Document Layout Generation
description: Generates hierarchical document layouts with a recursive variational autoencoder and introduces a structural similarity metric for dense document compositions (CVPRW 2020).

name: Machine Learning Model to Evaluate the Appropriateness of Layout for Automatic Generation of Graphic Design Works
description: Uses adversarial layout generation and a trained discriminator to generate and score graphic-design layouts conditioned on specified materials (IMCOM 2023).

name: Layout Generation for Various Scenarios in Mobile Shopping Apps
description: Introduces LayoutVQ-VAE, a discrete latent model for generating layouts under internal and scenario-level constraints in mobile shopping applications (CHI 2023).

name: Automatic Layout Planning for Visually-Rich Documents with Instruction-Following Models
description: Uses a multimodal instruction-following model to arrange user-provided visual elements for posters, brochures, book covers, advertisements, and related visually rich documents (ALVR 2024).
date_note: arXiv v1 predates ALVR 2024 workshop publication

name: Iris: a multi-constraint graphic layout generation system
description: Combines an interactive graphic-layout design system with multi-constraint LayoutVQ-VAE for background-aware generation, editing, and rendering (FITEE 2024).

name: LayoutKAG: Enhancing Layout Generation in Large Language Models Through Knowledge-Augmented Generation
description: Uses knowledge-augmented generation to improve large-language-model layout generation and control (AIHCIR 2024).

name: Seeing is Improving: Visual Feedback for Iterative Text Layout Refinement
description: Introduces VFLM, which iteratively renders and visually critiques SVG text layouts over background images, using visually grounded reinforcement learning to improve readability and aesthetics (CVPR 2026).

name: LaDe: Unified Multi-Layered Graphic Media Generation and Decomposition
description: Jointly generates full graphic-media designs and a flexible number of semantically meaningful RGBA layers, while also supporting image-to-layers decomposition with a latent diffusion transformer and RGBA VAE.

name: Rethinking Layered Graphic Design Generation with a Top-Down Approach
description: Introduces Accordion, a top-down framework that creates editable layered graphic designs from user intent or sketches by using a VLM for reference creation, design planning, and layer generation (ICCV 2025).

name: CreatiParser: Generative Image Parsing of Raster Graphic Designs into Editable Layers
description: Parses flattened graphic designs into editable text, background, and sticker layers using a VLM text-rendering protocol and multi-branch RGBA diffusion, with preference alignment via ParserReward.

name: DesignDiffusion: High-Quality Text-to-Design Image Generation with Diffusion Models
description: Generates complete design images directly from text with a one-stage diffusion model, character-aware embeddings and localization supervision, plus self-play preference optimization for visual-text quality (CVPR 2025).

name: OmniPSD: Layered PSD Generation with Diffusion Transformer
description: Uses a unified FLUX-based diffusion-transformer framework for both text-to-PSD generation and flattened-image-to-PSD decomposition with editable transparent layers and an RGBA VAE.

name: LayeringDiff: Layered Image Synthesis via Generation, then Disassembly with Generative Knowledge
description: Synthesizes a composite image with an off-the-shelf generator and then disassembles it into foreground and background layers using pretrained generative priors and high-frequency alignment.

name: Generative Image Layer Decomposition with Visual Effects
description: Introduces LayerDecomp for decomposing images into clean backgrounds and transparent foreground layers while preserving visual effects such as shadows and reflections (CVPR 2025).

name: Controllable Layered Image Generation for Real-World Editing
description: Introduces LASAGNA, a unified controllable framework that jointly generates composites, clean backgrounds, and transparent foreground layers with physically grounded visual effects.

name: PSDiffusion: Harmonized Multi-Layer Image Generation via Layout and Appearance Alignment
description: Generates multiple transparent layers simultaneously with a unified diffusion framework and global-layer interaction for coherent layout, contacts, shadows, and reflections (WACV 2026).

name: Text2Layer: Layered Image Generation using Latent Diffusion Model
description: Jointly generates background, foreground, layer mask, and composed image in a learned layered latent space, establishing an early diffusion-based layered compositing formulation.

name: PosterIQ
description: Design-driven poster understanding and generation benchmark with 7,765 image-annotation instances and 822 generation prompts covering layout parsing, typography, design quality, semantic intent, and composition-aware synthesis (CVPR 2026).
date_note: associated paper arXiv v1; official dataset release

name: Image-aware layout generation with user constraints for poster design
description: Generates poster layouts conditioned on a product image while satisfying user-specified element and partial-layout constraints (The Visual Computer 2025).
date_note: journal online publication; later arXiv mirror not used for chronology

name: PosterAgent: Agentic Poster Generation via Stage-Aware Reinforcement Learning
description: Frames poster creation as an agentic draft-and-iterative-refinement workflow trained with stage-aware reinforcement learning (ICML 2026).
